body:
Thank you very much for such a careful and thorough review, and for all the time and effort you put into independently checking our result. We honestly feel very humbled, and even a little embarrassed, that such a small improvement received such serious attention from the project.

Our work is essentially a very modest improvement built on top of the much more mature and substantial work of Kleddamag, Levy, and the Squares Project. Most of our work was carried out with AI assistance, including much of the computational exploration, code drafting and checking, organization of the verification process, and preparation of the written materials. Without the existing certificate framework and the careful work that came before us, this result would not have been possible.

The current credit, “Wang, Li after Kleddamag, Levy,” is completely fine with us.

Regarding AI assistance, we would be happy for the project record to state something along the lines of: “AI assistance was used for most of the computational exploration, code drafting and checking, organization of verification outputs, and preparation of the written materials.” We will also make this explicit in a revised Zenodo release.

Thank you as well for pointing out the packaging issues with the second verifier, the two different PDF builds, and the licence metadata. These are very helpful comments. We plan to clean these up in the revised Zenodo release, including making the published certificate the direct input to the independent verifier, unifying the canonical PDF, clarifying the licence information, and adding an explicit AI-assistance statement.

We have followed the Squares Project with great admiration, and we are deeply grateful that you and the other contributors were willing to take our small result seriously, verify it independently in several different ways, and incorporate it into the project record.

We are sure that you and the other contributors will continue to obtain much stronger and more meaningful results on this problem, and we sincerely wish you the very best with all of the ongoing work.

Thank you again, not only for reviewing our result so carefully, but also for all the work you have contributed to this project over the years. We have tremendous respect and admiration for all of your work.
